changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpainassessment AS SELECT pa.id, pa.patient_id, pa.encounter_id, pa.pain_degree, pa.pain_level, pa.pain_description, pa.pain_pattern, pa.is_active, pa.created_by, pa.created_date, pa.last_modified_by, pa.last_modified_date, pa.pain_assessment_type FROM public.pain_assessment pa;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpainassessment TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpainassessment FROM report_user;
